name: ptia-ops
description: Local PTIA operations tools for validating scheduled posts, site feed timing, and Buffer updates.

interface.shortDescription: Validate PTIA posts and Buffer scheduling.
interface.longDescription: PTIA Ops adds local tools for the PTIA Content Engine: scheduled post validation, copy/image issue checks, site feed timing checks, and single-post Buffer updates from validated local data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Validate today's PTIA scheduled posts and report any copy, image, Buffer, or site-feed issues before publishing.
